subject.title: fix(tui): complete approved terminal operator scope upgrades

question: Should the terminal UI request `operator.admin` together with write and approvals for every normal TUI connection, accepting that older read-only device tokens must be re-paired after approval?
rationale: The diff deliberately broadens the authorization request and changes upgrade behavior for persisted device credentials; source-level tests alone cannot decide whether `operator.admin` is the intended long-term operator boundary.

options.title: Confirm the full operator scope set
options.body: Keep all four requested scopes after reviewing redacted real-Gateway proof that pairing remains the only path to the broader token.

options.title: Narrow the requested scopes
options.body: Request only the capabilities demonstrated as necessary for ordinary terminal UI flows and retain explicit pairing for any separately invoked administrative action.

recommendation.title: Confirm the full operator scope set
recommendation.body: Keep all four requested scopes after reviewing redacted real-Gateway proof that pairing remains the only path to the broader token.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed scope set and accompanying upgrade behavior originate in the current TUI repair branch.
